newsitem.title: USA: W.W. Grainger in supply pact with Fel-Pro.
newsitem.headline: W.W. Grainger in supply pact with Fel-Pro.

text.p: W.W. Grainger Inc said Wednesday it signed a 10-year agreement with Fel-Pro Inc calling for Grainger to manage Fel-Pro's annual expenditures.

The contract calls for Grainger Integrated Supply Operations to assume responsibility for about $10 million that Fel-Pro spends each year for indirect materials that support its automotive parts operation, the company said.
Financial terms of the pact were not announced.
W.W. Grainger distributes maintenance, repair and operating supplies.
Its shares were off 1/4 Wednesday at 76-1/2.
